about.title: About ARXUN
about.p1: ARXUN Studio Pro is the culmination of years of research into digital asset integrity and secure transport protocols. Our mission is to provide creators and engineers with a unified platform for building, sealing, and managing proprietary data containers.
about.p2: Built on the Material 3 design system, ARXUN offers a seamless, intuitive experience that masks the complex cryptographic operations happening beneath the surface. Whether you're managing sensitive credentials in the Vault or previewing high-definition media, ARXUN ensures your data remains yours.
about.visionDesc: To become the industry standard for secure digital asset encapsulation.
about.techDesc: Leveraging advanced GSAP motion and Material 3 design principles.

guide.title: How to Use
guide.subtitle: Master the ARXUN Engine
guide.step1Desc: Start by navigating to the Build view. This is your primary workspace for asset assembly.
guide.step2Desc: Use the Control Deck to add files, notes, or vault entries. Our engine supports over 50+ formats.
guide.step3Desc: Click any asset to open the Universal Viewer. Review contents and metadata instantly.
guide.step4Desc: Once satisfied, click "Seal Archive" to encode your assets into a proprietary .arxun container.
guide.readyDesc: Your first high-definition archive is just a few clicks away. Experience the power of ARXUN today.
